author: Bill Ferguson
name: auto_straighten
description: Reads roll angle information from image metadata and applies a rotation correction in darkroom to level the image.
description-extensive: This tool automatically straightens crooked photos by reading the tilt angle your camera recorded when you took the shot, then rotating the image to level it against the nearest horizontal or vertical line. It saves you from manually straightening each photo. It needs the free exiftool program installed to read the angle information from your files.
